title: A batch gate that throws settles its batch and runs afresh
description: Runs the real gate over detached trial runs: a gate run that fails on a host fault records an error and settles its batch, each later cycle launches a fresh run on main's tip instead of replaying the finished one, and once the fault is gone the fresh run verifies main with no edit to the gate record (GY-3567).

steps.name: a fresh gate run verifies once the host fault is gone
